item: maintenance guards fail closed when unreadable (R396); two dropped exceptions logged (R386)
summary: BackgroundScheduler._run_off_peak_maintenance read four guards (memory, storage, damaged corpus file, post-crash check) in one try ending in except Exception: pass, so a guard that raised read as clear: maintenance ran and the damage guards failed open, silently, and one guard failing skipped the three after it. Each guard is now read on its own (_read_maint_guard); one that cannot be read refuses the window (skip reason guard_unreadable) and the log names the guard. _tail_journal_trim and the memory-pause reclaim, which ended in bare pass, log at DEBUG. Mutant-proven: restoring fail-open turns 5 tests red, restoring either pass turns 1 red.
